last_arriving_input_of_the_model.note: the packed feature vector is 38 bits; inside the feature unit f5 (8 bits) is the deepest. No input depends on the message's own price, size, type or side.

itch_5_0_add_order.conclusion: the book key (stock locate at offset 1, or the stock symbol at 24-31) arrives 4 to 31 bytes before the price (32-35); under the 87 definition of the features the conclusion is the same as for Bench Feed v1. A model with the order's own price or shares as an input would have the price (offset 32, 4 bytes) as its last input.
